orangePellet_box.desc:
The Orange or 'Omnivore' pellet provides basic nutrition with a mix of greens and meat.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
greenPellet_box.desc:
The Green or 'Herbivore' pellet provides basic nutrition with a slant towards greens.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
mussels_box.desc:
A mid-size mollusc that grows in densely packed beds containing millions of individuals.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
cockles_box.desc:
A small mollusc that is usually found buried in sand or fine gravel.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
coralFood_box.desc:
Zoo Plankton is suitable for feeding to filter feeders such as Corals.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
sandEel_box.desc:
A slim, low calorie fish, that is commonly found burrowed in sand substrate.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
spongePellet_box.desc:
This special pellet food has some ocean sponge in it which is required for some of your animals.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
artemia_box.desc:
A micro shrimp that is easy to culture and when fed live, is readily accepted by small or picky marine animals.

This live dispenser requires supply of feeder food to keep it producing day after day.
sprat_box.desc:
The high oil content of this fish is a large attractant to animals with a highly developed sense of smell, such as sharks.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
krill_box.desc:
A large and extremely nutritious shrimp that is high in protein.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
crab_box.desc:
A highly nutritious treat - but only for animals that can break through the crab's hard exterior.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
liveMysis_box.desc:
A small nutritious shrimp, rich in essential fatty acids.

This live dispenser requires supply of feeder food to keep it producing day after day.
liveLugWorms_box.desc:
Lug Worms are responsible for the coiled cast of sand found on beaches near the water. The coil marks the entrance to their burrow.

This live dispenser requires supply of feeder food to keep it producing day after day.
supplement_box.desc:
The Supplement Cabinet contains a plethora of different supplements for your fish. The frequency with which an animal requires supplements depends on the species.

This dispenser has a limited capacity, but is refilled at the beginning of each day.
